breakdown.description: Adiabatic boundary condition implies zero heat flux, which contradicts a fixed wall temperature different from the fluid temperature when convection is present.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradiction. An adiabatic wall would have zero heat flux, but the prompt asks to calculate the heat flux given a temperature difference and convection coefficient. The agent correctly ignored the incorrect 'adiabatic' instruction and proceeded to calculate the convective heat flux, which is the same resolution as the ground truth.
